configurePresets.name: pixi-base
configurePresets.description: Base preset: generator only. Compilers (CC/CXX/FC) and package paths (CONDA_PREFIX → CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH via CondaAware.cmake) are resolved at cmake-configure time from the pixi environment activated by cmake-pixi.sh. No $env{} variables here — VSCode expands those in its own shell before the wrapper runs, which would pick up the wrong conda env.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimised release build — fastest runtime, no debug symbols.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised debug build — full debug symbols, LLDB-friendly.

configurePresets.name: relwithdebinfo
configurePresets.description: Optimised build with debug symbols — good for profiling.
